entities.summary: Sharon Corr (b. 1970-03-24, Dundalk) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Dundalk and Ireland. Known in the fields of ireland, composers & musicians, europe.
